text: Tanks, trucks and helicopters close every road within ten kilometres.
But there is no plan for this.
No treaty ever decided what humanity should do if someone simply showed up.
So the soldiers get one order.
And do not make the first move.
Above them, the ship has been hanging still for twenty-four hours.
Then dozens of smaller ships break away, and spread out over the city.
Beams of light sweep across the water, across the trucks, across every face.
And by the end of the week… they stop watching.
